chapter: Early career: vaudeville and Kansas City
title: Sonny Thompson, the Gonzel White show and leaving it in Kansas City
summary: Basie identifies Sonny Thompson as a drummer and confirms two years with the Gonzel White show, which ended in Kansas City around 1927, and a bout of illness.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Yeah. Okay. With Sonny Thompson Band on Keith Orpheum Circuit?
Yep? Okay. All righty. Who's Sonny Thompson anyway?
Now we're back to two years with Gonzel White Show. This is still children's --

: Yep, she's back. Accompanying -- no, wait. "Left the show in Kansas City in 1927." All right, that's when it supposedly broke up, right? "After serious illness, began accompanying Whitman Sisters." You were seriously ill in Kansas City, I guess, then?
That was when I was ill.
: Okay, all right, so you were not seriously ill in Kansas City?
